- Common diagnostic surfaces and justified test samples.
- Signed bending and displacement-response observables.

- Vacuum/material comparison controls and failure denominators.

- Explicit prohibition on candidate ranking before adequate evidence.

Existing sources suffice; no catalogue edits. Whitespace and 30 session-record validations passed. Ready to independently review the vacuum-solenoid benchmark.
